items.note: Stock eye-beat for surprise or shock; overwhelmingly AI fiction formula
items.example: Her eyes widened when she saw what lay behind the door.

items.note: Stock eye-beat for grief; one of the most documented AI fiction trigrams
items.example: His eyes filled with tears as the words sank in.

items.note: Stock gaze-lock beat used to manufacture intensity without describing anything
items.example: She crossed the room, eyes never leaving his face.

items.note: Stock eye-beat for dangerous amusement or cunning; AI formula
items.example: His eyes glinted as he considered the offer.

items.note: Stock eye-beat compound for playful character moments
items.example: She leaned in, eyes sparkling with mischief.

items.note: Stock physical description; one of the most-cited AI fiction trigrams from slop-score research
items.example: He fixed her with his piercing blue eyes.

items.note: Purple-prose eye substitute; nearly absent from pre-AI fiction
items.example: Her sapphire orbs met his across the crowded ballroom.

items.note: Stock confusion/concentration face beat; high frequency in AI fiction trigrams; some legitimate use
items.example: His brow furrowed as he read the letter a second time.

items.note: Stock suppressed-anger face beat; extremely common in AI romance and thriller
items.example: Her jaw clenched but she said nothing.

items.note: Variant of jaw-clench body beat; slightly less common in human writing
items.example: His jaw tightened at the accusation.

items.note: Stock surprise body beat; documented AI fiction formula
items.example: She took a sharp intake of breath when the figure stepped into the light.

items.note: Stock composure-seeking beat; explicitly listed in slop-score trigrams; exists in human writing but vastly overused in AI fiction
items.example: He took a deep breath before opening the door.

items.note: Stock tension-release beat; AI uses for any emotional transition
items.example: She let out a breath she hadn't realized she'd been holding.

items.note: Stock anxiety body beat; near-universal in AI fiction for pre-conflict dread
items.example: A knot formed in her stomach as she knocked on the door.

items.note: Stock dread body beat; AI formula for revelation or bad news
items.example: Her stomach dropped when she saw the missed calls.

items.note: Variant of stomach-drop dread beat; AI cycles through these somatic verbs
items.example: His stomach twisted as the silence stretched on.

items.note: Stock romantic-attraction body beat; explicitly in slop-score trigrams
items.example: Her heart skipped a beat when he smiled at her.

items.note: Stock disappointment body beat; present in human writing but heavily overused in AI fiction
items.example: His heart sank as he read the rejection.

items.note: Stock excitement or fear body beat; AI formula for any heightened moment
items.example: Her pulse quickened as the footsteps grew closer.

items.note: Stock horror body beat; well-documented cliche across AI fiction catalogs
items.example: His blood ran cold when he recognized the voice.

items.note: Stock embarrassment/attraction blush beat; AI formula
items.example: Heat rose to her cheeks and she looked away.

items.note: Compressed blush beat variant; AI cycles between this and 'heat rose to cheeks'
items.example: His cheeks flushed under her gaze.

items.note: Intensified blush beat; listed in romance-cliche and antislop research; rarely in pre-AI prose
items.example: Cheeks flaming, she turned and walked away.

items.note: Stock unease body beat; variant of spine-shiver already in rules; this form triggers on non-spine objects
items.example: A shiver ran down her arms at the sound.

items.note: Stock near-whisper voice qualifier; documented formula across AI fiction; differs from existing 'barely a whisper' template
items.example: Her voice was barely above a whisper when she answered.

items.note: Second variant of whisper-voice beat not fully caught by existing template
items.example: He spoke, voice barely audible above the rain.

items.note: Stock dramatic-pause atmosphere beat; explicitly in slop-score trigrams
items.example: The room fell silent when she walked in.

items.note: Weighted variant of room-fell-silent beat; AI uses to mark emotional weight
items.example: A heavy silence fell between them.

items.note: Tension-silence beat using spatial verb; AI fiction formula
items.example: The silence stretched between them until it became unbearable.

items.note: Stock horror/suspense atmosphere beat; explicitly in slop-score trigrams
items.example: The door creaked open to reveal an empty hallway.

items.note: Stock moody-setting descriptor; explicitly in slop-score trigrams; nearly a genre stamp
items.example: He found her sitting alone in a dimly lit room.

items.note: Stock abandoned-space atmospheric detail; explicitly in slop-score trigrams; almost absent from pre-AI fiction
items.example: Dust motes danced in the shaft of light from the window.

items.note: Stock tension atmosphere beat; AI uses for any charged emotional scene; distinct from 'air thick with'
items.example: The air crackled between them as neither spoke.

items.note: Compressed crackle-tension variant; AI formula for charged scenes
items.example: Tension crackled in the silence that followed.

items.note: Stock anxious thought beat; explicitly in slop-score as 'mind racing with possibilities/questions'; some legitimate use
items.example: Her mind was racing as she tried to piece it together.

items.note: Stock thriller entrance beat; explicitly in slop-score trigrams
items.example: A figure emerged from the shadows at the end of the hall.

items.note: Stock resolution-beat closer; explicitly in slop-score trigrams
items.example: She left the meeting with a renewed sense of purpose.

items.note: Variant of renewed-sense-of-purpose closer; slop-score trigram
items.example: He walked away with a newfound sense of purpose.

items.text: life would never be the same
items.note: Stock pivotal-event closer; documented in slop-score narrative closer trigrams
items.example: After that night, she knew life would never be the same.

items.note: Stock solidarity closer; slop-score narrative closer trigram
items.example: Whatever came next, they would face it together.

items.note: Stock subtle-amusement face beat; explicitly in slop-score trigrams as 'smile playing on lips'
items.example: A smile played on her lips as she read his reply.

items.note: Suppressed-smile variant face beat; AI cycles between this and 'smile played on lips'
items.example: The corner of her mouth twitched despite herself.

items.note: Stock involuntary reaction qualifier; listed in romance-cliche and antislop catalogs; signals AI attributing emotion against character will
items.example: She found herself laughing despite herself.

items.note: Variant of 'words hung in the air' not identical to existing 'words hung heavy in the air' template; distinct enough to add
items.example: His words hung in the air long after he'd left.

items.note: Abstracted variant of the hanging-in-air beat; AI formula for unexpressed tension
items.example: Something unspoken hung between them all evening.

items.note: Vague internal-state change beat; AI uses to mark emotional turning points without specifying what changed
items.example: Something shifted in his expression when she said his name.

items.note: Stock unspecified-emotion eye beat; AI uses to suggest depth without naming the feeling
items.example: Something flickered in his eyes but was gone before she could read it.

items.note: Stock irresistible-attraction metaphor; listed in romance-cliche catalogs and antislop-sampler
items.example: She was drawn to him like a moth to a flame.

items.note: Stock wild-action qualifier; listed in romance/fiction cliche catalogs and antislop-sampler
items.example: He threw himself into the work with reckless abandon.

items.note: Stock burden metaphor; AI applies to any responsibility or grief beat; present in human writing but AI overuses in fiction
items.example: She felt the weight of the world on her shoulders as she walked home.

items.note: Vague emotional-state placeholder; AI uses to claim complexity without specifying the emotions
items.example: She felt a mix of emotions she couldn't quite name.

items.note: Stock emotional-surge framing; 'a wave of relief/sadness/panic' is AI formula for any sudden feeling
items.example: A wave of exhaustion washed over him the moment he sat down.

items.note: Variant of wave-of emotional-surge beat; AI cycles between wave/surge/flood
items.example: A surge of anger rose in her chest.

items.note: Stock rising-emotion body beat; AI formula for grief or love scenes
items.example: Something warm welled up inside her as she watched him sleep.

items.note: Stock processing-shock thought beat; explicitly in slop-score trigrams
items.example: She stood in the doorway, trying to make sense of what she was seeing.

items.note: Stock disgust or horror body beat; AI formula for revulsion
items.example: Bile rose in her throat as she read the report.

items.note: Stock positive-emotion body beat; AI formula for comfort, love, or alcohol scenes
items.example: A warmth spread through her chest at his words.

items.note: Stock loss-of-consciousness or despair closer; AI formula for chapter or scene endings
items.example: She reached out once more before the darkness closed in.

items.note: Stock forward-momentum closer; slop-score narrative closer trigram
items.example: The hard part was over, but the real work was only just getting started.
